name: Magic: pick Wind Strike for autocast on the combat tab with a staff, fight a castle man from one Attack click, then defensive autocast's Defence XP, then a style button turning autocast off

steps.comment: a new account's stats, nothing worn or carried; ::reset at the end puts the account back
toplevel:stone0, the combat tab, in the fixed frame the VM's client uses: the interfaces below only count as open while the tab shows
the combat tab's Choose spell (the button without the shield)
the autocast menu in the combat tab's place
Wind Strike, enum 1986 key 1; level 1, so a bare account can cast it, and with a 2 max hit a man takes at least four casts
the combat tab back
the server fights with the spell now
the nearest man; in range and in sight there is no walk
human_caststrike_staff
windstrike_casting on the player
windstrike_impact if it hit, failedspell_impact if it splashed
a second cast 5 ticks after the first, with no second click
the staff of fire gives no air runes
5.5 a cast, more for damage
the man fights back once cast on; ::kill picks the man attacking you
the shield button: defensive autocast
another man, or the same one back after his respawn
defensive autocast: 1 Defence XP a point of damage; the bare account starts with none
the first style button: autocast goes off
the staff's first style, from the cache's dbtable 78
